title: Autoantibodies against cytokines and their role in the pathogenesis of viral infections
summary: The study investigates whether antibodies against certain messenger molecules of the immune system increase the likelihood of contracting or becoming seriously ill from certain viral infections. Archived left-over samples from the Institute of Clinical Microbiology and Hygiene at Regensburg University Hospital are used.

interventions.name: Retrospective cohorts with confirmed viral infections (BoDV-1, herpes simplex encephalitis, herpes zoster)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
archived serum (Institute for Clinical Microbiology and Hygiene, University Hospital Regensburg) from patients with evidence of the respective infectious disease (BoDV-1, TBE, HSV-1 encephalitis, herpes zoster), purely retrospective
Exclusion criteria:
none
